Chrysler Limo

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. The Chrysler Limo is the classic stretch: black on the outside with ambient lighting and privacy tint, the long silhouette everybody turns to look at. Up to eight on classic, comfortable leather seats.

About the Chrysler Limo

A wet bar with custom lights, a custom sound system with subs, and seventeen colour variations for the cabin lighting, so the mood matches the night.

The one for prom, Cinco de Mayo, the anniversary, the date night, the night with friends, the concert, and any event that deserves a stretch limo at the curb.

Seats: Classic, comfortable leather seats

Chrysler Limo rental in Scottsdale, Phoenix and Paradise Valley: chauffeured by the hour from $150 with a 4-hour minimum, or as a one-way airport and event transfer from $350. Seats 8.
